title: Tampa Bay OTT Advertising Company | Over The Top & CTV Marketing

facts.fact: Mocentric's Tampa Bay OTT advertising company offers a free consultation for prospective OTT advertising clients.
facts.quote: Our Tampa Bay OTT advertising company offers the latest in over the top marketing services, get a free consultation today!

facts.fact: Mocentric states that its customer dashboard is available 24/7 so clients can analyze OTT campaign performance up to the second.
facts.unit: hours per day, days per week
facts.quote: Our 24/7 customer dashboard gives you up-to-the-second ability to analyze and evaluate the performance of your OTT campaign.

facts.fact: Mocentric defines OTT (Over the Top) advertising as video ads placed on streaming platforms such as Peacock, Pluto, Hulu, and Sling.
facts.quote: OTT stands for Over the Top, which is just another way to say video advertisements that you place on streaming platforms like Peacock, Pluto, Hulu, Sling, and many others.

facts.fact: Mocentric says its OTT data shows what a target audience is watching, when they are watching, and on which device.
facts.quote: Our data lets you know the behavior of your audience—what they’re watching, when they’re watching, and on what device.

facts.fact: Mocentric claims to have worked with Fortune 500 companies as well as small local businesses on OTT campaigns.
facts.quote: We’ve worked with Fortune 500 companies, small local businesses, and everything in between with proven success.
